headline: Reliance Gets Relief from Delhi High Court in Campa Energy Drink Case; FSSAI Order Stayed | Campa Energy Drink Fssai Order Delhi High Court
summary: The Delhi High Court granted Reliance Consumer Products interim relief in the Campa Energy Drink case, allowing continued use of the term 'Energy Drink'. The FSSAI order of June 30 is stayed; the next hearing is November 5.
why: Reliance Consumer Products is a consumer goods unit of Reliance Industries, India's largest listed company by market value. Regulatory disputes over product labelling can affect brand sales and compliance costs.
